details: Every composite number can be expressed uniquely as a product of prime numbers, up to the order of factors.
Prime factor tree visualization decomposes composite numbers iteratively into prime branches.
HCF(a, b) is the product of the smallest power of each common prime factor involved in the numbers.
LCM(a, b) is the product of the greatest power of each prime factor involved in the numbers.
For any two positive integers a and b: HCF(a, b) * LCM(a, b) = a * b.
evidence_or_examples: Relation HCF * LCM = a * b holds ONLY for two positive integers, not three.

details: Let p be a prime number. If p divides a^2 (where a is a positive integer), then p divides a.
evidence_or_examples: If 2 divides a^2, then 2 divides a; used as key lemma in irrationality proofs.

details: Assume the number is rational in lowest terms p/q where p and q are coprime integers (q != 0).
Derive that the prime factor divides both p and q, contradicting the coprime assumption.
